Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
I see you are advertising Highways and Byways in Spain. I should be much obliged if I might have a copy as my [Sister in law](../persons.html#1604) and her daughters are at Algeciras, where the [husband](../persons.html#386) of [one](../persons.html#388) is Vice Consul. I am expecting the [elder one](../persons.html#1613) to return before the end of the month, and the book would be much enjoyed by us together.
I am glad [Modern Broods](../books.html#251) is doing well.

It is more than I expected, for I do not think I can attempt any more of the kind after a long spell of success.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
